description: Kingfisher rules whose validator may run for a project that opted into secret validation (docs/SECRETS-PLAN.md 5.2). Each value is the sha256 of the rule's validation block in the pinned rule bundle, as cveFeed.secrets_validation.validator_hash reads it; tests/test_secrets_validation.py recomputes them from the bundle in CI, and a rule whose hash no longer matches leaves the list until a person reviews its validator again. Rules for the list: identity or metadata calls only (GET, or a named identity POST such as Slack auth.test), nothing billable, no write. helpers are rules the validators read a component from (the AWS secret key): they are loaded in the validating pass and must have no validator of their own.

reviewed.betterleaks.aws-access-token: aws.validate: STS GetCallerIdentity with the key ID and the secret key component (Kingfisher validation/aws.rs)
reviewed.betterleaks.gcp-api-key: GET identitytoolkit v3 getProjectConfig, then GET generativelanguage v1beta models (a list, not a generation call)
reviewed.betterleaks.slack-bot-token: POST auth.test (Slack's identity endpoint, no side effect)
reviewed.betterleaks.slack-user-token: POST auth.test (Slack's identity endpoint, no side effect)
